title: Ready-made oath confirmation repeats Cost: 10 minutes and $0
body:
Road Warden / Wolf-Winter **ready-made setup and oath confirmation** repeats the same **“Cost: 10 minutes and $0”** line twice in one consequence paragraph.

This 200-player grok-4.6 (low) MCP wave (build `36ff6d106fa0df2ff19e80d09cf00df081b81653`): S1 clusters `7e44e57fe9ecfd7b` (10 reports), `2dd0a12561569f85` (9), `3924c9e418e1bc18` (8), `22e53209b306e403` (7), plus many S0 singles. Example seeds: `1900000014`, `1900000036`, `1900000047`. Cosmetic, but it is on the first civic confirmation every player hits.

Fix: emit the cost line once.

evidence.summary: Grok-4.6 low MCP 200-wave ticket 7e44e57fe9ecfd7b (10 S1) plus adjacent duplicate-cost clusters.
